text:
sara-infra: quick follow-up from last night's postmortem. we saw a multi-region spike in TLS handshake failures correlated with DNS rotation windows and a route preference bug. need to lock owners, short/medium/long term mitigations, and concrete SLAs for fixes.

mike-sre: i'll own the LB route-preference rollback and an emergency runbook. i'll draft explicit rollback steps + a safe canary plan. aim to have playbook + smoke tests in 3 days.

tanvi-net: i'll investigate the registrar throttling behavior and TTL jitter root cause. registrar support hinted at rate limits on mass record updates; want to add a zone-rollout runbook and a staging publish hill-climb. target 7 business days for full RCA + runbook.

jordan-eng: i'll own client retry behavior and exponential backoff tuning. will add feature-flag + metrics and a fallback path if cross-region TLS is flaky. expecting a PR for canary in 4 days.

deploy-bot: deploy 4120 to prod (canary: ap-southeast-1) completed; no error spike during deploy window.

mike-sre: sample safe rollback snippet for haproxy (WIP):
```
# switch traffic to stable route-table
frontend api_front
  acl is_api hdr(host) -i api.redwoodinference.com
  use_backend stable_backend if is_api
```
I'll include verification queries and an automated health-check step in the playbook.

tanvi-net: alert tuning proposal: mute noisy retry alerts during scheduled zone publishes and add a low-latency synthetic probe that checks TLS handshake success from each region. example expr to reduce noise:
```
expr: increase(edge_tls_handshake_failures[10m]) / increase(edge_tls_handshake_attempts[10m]) > 0.015
for: 10m
```
Also proposing a maintenance tag for DNS updates so ops-alerts can skip noisy windows.

jordan-eng: sandbox test numbers: after backoff change retries dropped from ~3.8% -> 0.5% for simulated cross-region flows. will roll to 5% canary then 25%.

sara-infra: good. capture action items here so weekly incident review can track. we'll surface blockers in the channel and escalate if deadlines slip.

Action items (owner 14 due):
- LB route-preference rollback + emergency playbook 14 mike-sre 14 72h
- Registrar throttle RCA + zone-rollout runbook 14 tanvi-net 14 7d
- Retry/backoff feature-flag PR + canary plan 14 jordan-eng 14 4d
- Synthetic regional TLS canaries + alert suppression rules 14 tanvi-net 14 5d
- Postmortem doc updates (timeline + graphs) 14 sara-infra 14 48h

mike-sre: i'll schedule an ops maintenance window placeholder and coordinate on-call for the rollback window.

tanvi-net: will attach registrar logs and the zone publish script to the runbook PR. note: registrar returns 429 on bursts and batches larger than ~30 updates — will include a stagger plan.

jordan-eng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/retries/pull/451 14 includes config flags, new backoff constants, and telemetry. canary gating set to 5% traffic.

sara-infra: added a standing 10am PT check-in on next Tue for progress. ops-bot created weekly follow-up event.

ops-bot: Reminder: incident follow-up meeting scheduled on 2026-03-31 10:00 PT.

mike-sre: will post playbook link and smoke test queries when ready.

sara-infra: closing thread for now; will reopen if any owner reports blocker or misses the 72h LB deliverable. :lock:
